title: 30A Ciel Bleu
meta_description: 30A Ciel Bleu is a soft-blue coastal retreat with 3 ensuite bedrooms \& rocking-chair porches, a stroll from Alys Beach \& Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
On the quiet east end of Scenic Highway 30A, where Seacrest gives way to the white courtyards of Alys Beach, this soft-blue coastal retreat trades the beachfront bustle for something calmer --- leafy palms, breezy walkways, and two of 30A's most celebrated towns within an easy stroll. Alys Beach's cafes and boutiques are about a ten-minute walk from the door, Rosemary Beach's cobblestone town center and the shops of 30Avenue sit just beyond, and the sugar-white sand is a quick bike ride or short drive away, with Camp Helen State Park and the rare coastal dune lakes a few minutes farther east.

Inside, the living space is bright, airy, and built for coming together. Sunlight pours through tall windows onto a cozy sectional arranged around the fireplace and TV --- an easy place to land after a full day of sun and saltwater. The circular dining table and kitchen island share hosting duties, and the fully stocked kitchen backs them up with stainless steel appliances, barstool seating, and both a Keurig and a drip coffee maker, so nobody has to compromise on their morning cup.

Three spacious bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, give groups of up to eight genuine privacy. The primary suite pairs a king bed with a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower; the second suite offers another king and a sleek walk-in shower of its own; and the third flexes for families or friends with a king bed plus two twins.

Then there are the porches --- classic, Southern, made for rocking chairs and slow mornings. Fire up the BBQ for a cookout, carry dinner out into the Gulf breeze, or take the balcony for sunset. With a washer and dryer on hand, 30A Ciel Bleu settles as easily into a long stay as a quick escape --- true to its name, a little pocket of blue sky on Florida's most beloved shoreline, with 30A's bike paths, dune lakes, and emerald water all right there when you're ready.

AMENITY ACCESS: In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.

\*\*\* Attention Guests, please note that there is an additional fee of $2 per day per guest staying at this property in Seacrest Beach. We are required by the Seacrest Beach HOA to collect this fee in order for you to stay in this community and use their amenities. We will collect this fee prior to your arrival.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A pack'n'play is available upon request for little ones.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- This home offers parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
